claims.text: KAR is an end-to-end MRC model that explicitly uses general knowledge to assist its attention mechanisms.
KAR is designed to improve performance and robustness compared to state-of-the-art MRC models.
KAR incorporates a data enrichment method to extract inter-word semantic connections for better performance.
